payload.reason: The evidence indicates that face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated components of a multimodal system for audio-visual meeting transcription, which suggests they are not programmed by hand but rather are part of an automated process.

claims.text: Face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated components of a multimodal audio-visual transcription system.
The system utilizes multiple cues from different modalities to achieve robust speaker attribution.
The integration of these components improves the system's ability to handle real-world challenges such as overlapping speech.
